fields.title: Sepsis after surgery
fields.roleNote: Stay out of the way until the group has answered. Ask what they noticed before telling them. Give cues in the patient's voice, not as hints about the answer.

watchFor: Recognize cues: which facts raise the patient's risk?
cueCards.cue: Outgoing nurse: 'Stable overnight. Just keep an eye on them today.'
cueCards.ifStuck: Ask: which of these facts could make this patient unwell?
cueCards.moveOn: Move on when every question is answered and the rationale has been read.

watchFor: Recognize cues: which observations are changing?
Analyze cues: what do the trends mean?
cueCards.cue: Patient: 'I just feel a bit off today.'
cueCards.ifStuck: Ask: what has changed since the last stage? Which numbers moved?
cueCards.moveOn: Move on when every question is answered and the rationale has been read.

watchFor: Prioritize hypotheses: what is most likely?
Generate solutions: what could you do?
cueCards.cue: Patient: 'Something is wrong. I don't feel right.'
cueCards.ifStuck: Ask: what do you think is happening, and what makes you think so?
cueCards.moveOn: Move on when every question is answered and the rationale has been read.
